query: WanVideo BlockSwap causes unbounded system-RAM growth on Windows (96GB filled by ~3rd run, pinned-memory related), and sageattn_3 + torch.compile either OOMs, degrades quality, or reduce-overhead fails (cudaMallocAsync pool conflict on Windows). Self-resolved with detailed evidence, 0 comments.

desired.outcome: OP self-confirmed workarounds with logs: run ComfyUI with --disable-pinned-memory and replace the WanVideo BlockSwap node with the older 'WanVideo Enhanced BlockSwap' node — this stopped RAM growth and enabled 1920x1024x61-frame generation on a 5060 Ti 16GB. For sageattn_3: use the per_block_mean sageattn3 mode (or keep SageAttention 2.2 for first/last steps); torch.compile reduce-overhead is blocked by Windows cudaMallocAsync pool limits (not fixable via --disable-cuda-malloc).
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
desired.answer_guidance: OP self-confirmed workarounds with logs: run ComfyUI with --disable-pinned-memory and replace the WanVideo BlockSwap node with the older 'WanVideo Enhanced BlockSwap' node — this stopped RAM growth and enabled 1920x1024x61-frame generation on a 5060 Ti 16GB. For sageattn_3: use the per_block_mean sageattn3 mode (or keep SageAttention 2.2 for first/last steps); torch.compile reduce-overhead is blocked by Windows cudaMallocAsync pool limits (not fixable via --disable-cuda-malloc).
desired.guidance_note: Known fix from the original issue thread. Use to verify the diagnosis targets the right root cause; alternative fixes that resolve the same root cause are acceptable.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Separately diagnose (a) unbounded pinned-memory RAM growth on Windows (fix: --disable-pinned-memory + older WanVideo Enhanced BlockSwap node) and (b) sageattn_3/torch.compile conflicts (per_block_mean mode; avoid reduce-overhead on Windows).
